author: IGN
description:
In today's Daily Fix:
Xbox has revealed the prices for their previously announced new price hike for the Series X and Series S. In the Europe and U.K., the consoles will cost roughly a third more than their current price across all models. In the U.S. the Xbox Series S 512GB model—the lowest-end of the Series family—is now an eye-watering $499.99, the same price the higher-end Series X launched at in 2020. In the U.K., the Xbox Series X 1TB with disc drive is now £669.99 (was £499.99) and in Europe, it's €799.99 (was €599.99). The Xbox Series X 2TB model has been discontinued entirely. In other news, Nintendo has announced a new Direct focusing on the upcoming Fire Emblem: Fortune's Weave. The Nintendo Direct will premiere tomorrow, August 4th 7am PST. And finally, Spider-Man: Brand New Day has exceeded even the most bullish expectations in its opening weekend, making more than $360 million domestically, and a walloping $930 million worldwide. Globally, it sits just behind Avengers: E
title: Xbox Reveals Shocking New Series X and S Prices - IGN Daily Fix

Beyond light and dark lies a power never seen before. Watch the final trailer for Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi, an upcoming all-new 8-episode limited anime series. Star Wars: Visions Presents - The Ninth Jedi streams August 5 on Disney+ and Hulu.

The limited series picks up not long after the events of the “Visions” shorts: “The Ninth Jedi” and “The Ninth Jedi: Child of Hope.” In the new series, Lah Kara continues to train in the ways of the Jedi under Margrave Juro. Kara goes on an epic journey of self-discovery as she and Juro’s small fellowship of Jedi-in-training embark on a quest to save her father.

Star Wars: Visions Presents – The Ninth Jedi is directed by Shunsuke Tada and written by Mitsuyasu Sakai. Kenji Kamiyama serves as supervising director. The executive producers are James Waugh, Jacqui Lopez, Josh Rimes, Justin Leach, and Mitsuhisa Ishikawa, the producers are Hitoshi Ito and Kanako Shirasaki, and the co-producer is Caroline Keller.

author: IGN
description:
Check out the trailer for Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother, an upcoming drama action film starring Mahershala Ali, John Cho, Abubakr Ali, Laith Nakli, Tramell Tillman, Tiffany Boone, and Giancarlo Esposito, also starring Adia and Jahleel Kamara.

From writer-director Bassam Tariq, Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother stars Mahershala Ali as Latif, a devoutly religious hitman who struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him - and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.


Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother is produced by Lucan Toh, p.g.a., Babak Anvari, and Bassam Tariq, p.g.a. Brian O’Neill serves as executive producer. 

Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother opens in select US theaters on September 25, and in theaters everywhere in October.
title: Your Mother Your Mother Your Mother - Official Trailer (2026) Mahershala Ali, John Cho
